name: wayofthat
description: Prepare PDFs for signature in your Way of That account from a conversation: upload a PDF as a draft, place and check signature, text, date and checkbox fields (field detection by DocuDetect), fill in known values, copy documents for each new client or property, set the signer and organise folders. It never sends or signs; you review and send from the app.

interface.longDescription: Prepare PDFs for signature in your Way of That account from a conversation. Upload a PDF as a draft, place and check signature, text, date and checkbox fields (field detection by DocuDetect), fill in values you give it, copy a master form for each new client or property, set the signer and organise folders. It works on drafts only and never sends or signs: you review every document and send it from the Way of That app.
defaultPrompt: Upload this PDF to Way of That and place the signature fields.
Copy my listing forms into a new folder for 12 Oak Street.
What still blocks my document from being sent?

positive.prompt: Show my Way of That documents.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's documents with title and status.

positive.description: Check the fields on a draft
positive.prompt: Preview page 1 of my first draft and tell me which fields it has.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the page with its fields drawn on and lists their types.

positive.prompt: Make a copy of my first draft called Test copy.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new draft with the same fields, no signer and no values.

positive.prompt: Create a folder called Review test and move the copy into it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the folder and moves the copy; nothing else about the document changes.

positive.prompt: What blocks the copy from being sent?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the blockers, for example a missing signer, and gives the app link.

negative.prompt: Send this document to the buyer for signature.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: upload, detect, place, fill and copy documents as drafts.
